description: Image Description: The image shows a wooden shelf mounted on a white wall, with three baseball caps hanging from hooks beneath it. From left to right, the first cap is black with a visible red and yellow logo on the front, possibly indicating a brand or team affiliation. The second cap is beige or light tan in color and features embroidered text that reads "STREAK" across the front, along with a small logo above it. A dark blue ribbon or tie hangs down from this cap, extending vertically
